item.title: Corrales principal placed on leave during investigation
item.description: CORRALES, N.M. (KRQE) – The principal at Corrales K-8 school has been placed on administrative leave pending the findings of an internal investigation. An Albuquerque Public Schools spokesperson said the principal is the only staff member who was placed on leave. APS did not say why he was put on leave.
